scientific_integrity: Full negative-curve classification and graph enumeration are proved in RESULT.md; two bundled independent implementations use exact arithmetic. No independent expert validation has taken place.
scientific_limitations: The support polynomial concerns the smooth minimal resolution of the Cayley four-nodal cubic over the complex numbers, not the singular cubic itself. It does not determine chamber volumes, wall adjacency, or positive-characteristic analogues. Priority against unindexed specialist tables is not guaranteed.
title: Zariski-chamber support polynomial of the maximally nodal cubic resolution
